content.text: Supported by the positive revenue development and the first- time earnings contribution from Varian, adjusted EBIT increased  by  $40\,\%$   from the prior-year period. This results in an adjusted  EBIT margin of   $17.4\,\%$   for the fiscal year 2021 compared to   $15.5\%$   in the prior year. The increase is mainly due to the strong  margin development in Diagnostics, which was driven by high  demand for rapid COVID-19 antigen tests.

The adjusted EBIT margin of Imaging was  $21.1\,\%$   at prior-year  level. Positive impacts from revenue growth were mainly off - set by higher expenses for performance-related remuneration  components and negative currency effects. Adjusted EBIT in- creased to  $\textup{\texteuro}2,076$   million.

The change in valuation allowances recorded in the consolidated  statements of income related to an increase in the valuation al- lowances on receivables from the sale of goods and services in  fiscal year 2021 by  $\epsilon22$   million (2020: increase by  $\epsilon27$   million).  Other changes mainly included additions in connection with the  acquisition of Varian.
